# Rindfall

> A sieve puzzle in a cheese cellar. An iPhone physics puzzle: slide perforated copper sieves so cheeses (Bite, Round, Wheel) drop by size
> into the right crates. 60 solver-checked levels in 4 caves, no ads, offline. Coming soon to the App Store.

## Pages
- [Home](https://nguyenvanlamm.github.io/rindfall-site/index.html.md): what the game is, caves, helpers, purchases
- [Support](https://nguyenvanlamm.github.io/rindfall-site/support.html.md): contact, how to play, restoring purchases
- [Privacy Policy](https://nguyenvanlamm.github.io/rindfall-site/privacy.html.md): nothing collected; local progress only
